items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: One thing about Dave, he puts on a great show.

ctx.x: And good luck with the Klezmer tonight and the whole thing. © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-
I’m sure it’ll be great. He’s always great. One thing about Dave, he puts on a great show. Sorry you won’t be there but it’s okay.
Well we are expecting you at Hamilton again next fall.
